title: Devices never checked in after enrolment
when: DaysSince(it.EnrolledOn) > params.minAgeDays && (it.LastSync == null || DaysSince(it.LastSync) >= DaysSince(it.EnrolledOn) - params.maxEnrolmentLagDays)

maxEnrolmentLagDays.text: Days of check-in lag after enrolment that still count as never settled

maxStuckPct.text: Share of enrolled Windows devices before this is worth reporting

minAgeDays.text: Days after enrolment before a silent device is treated as stuck

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows {Plural(Items.Count, 'device enrolled', 'devices enrolled')} and never settled with Intune

messages.businessImpact: These machines enrolled and then never spoke to Intune again, which is what a failed Autopilot or Enrollment Status Page run looks like. They hold an identity and none of the policy the enrolment was meant to deliver.
remediation: Find whether provisioning failed, the device left the network, or the record is stale, then re-provision or clean up.
messages.cannotSee: Intune records enrolment as a check-in, so a device whose last check-in fell within a day of its enrolment has not been heard from since. One that settled and then went quiet later is DEV-001's question instead. A device enrolled in the last few days is left out until it has had time to settle. All times are UTC.
